neighbours.label: the digit 8 inside a number, or the 0 right after it, as in the decade 1980s or the number 80

notes: Card: '8' x9 and '0' x8 of the top 32, plus one-off outliers such as ' earth' (the alkaline-earth probe scored 0.790, but 'rare earth' and 'save the earth' were under 0.02). Probes: '1980s' 0.46-0.65, '80' 0.18; 1930s/1950s/317/65 under 0.04. The 8 in 1948 only 0.128, so some fire items may be weak.
